lines.text: The man brought Ezekiel to the east gate, and the earth shone with the glory of the God of Israel.
The Spirit brought Ezekiel into the inner court, and the LORD said He would dwell among Israel for a season.
Ezekiel was to describe the temple so Israel would be ashamed, and its surrounding territory on the mountain would be most holy.
The altar's statutes said to give a young bull as a sin offering to the priests of Aaron's family.
